title: What A Waste
text:
What A Waste. Three stars is being generous for this. I needed a new mini chopper and thought I would take a chance on this one.
Pros:
It has an insert that you can use if you only have a small amount of something to chop

Cons:
Cheap, cheap, cheap
Be sure you inspect and clean the parts very well before the first use because there were all kinds of loose plastic strands in mine.
The cord wrap on the bottom is positively useless
It comes with a built in spatula. Why bother? It is is hard to get the spatula lined up in the storage place.
Said spatula storage place makes it impossible to store upright in a drawer, therefore taking up as much space laying down as a regular sized processor.

All in all I wish I had kept my Kitchen Aid and lived with it's quirks.
